description: Groundwater and drought in Ethiopia is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by British Geological Survey. In 1998 the Department for International Development (DFID) funded the project ‘Groundwater drought early warning for vulnerable areas’ as part of the DFID Knowledge and Research (KaR) programme, a collaboration between UK partners BGS and the Overseas Development Institute (ODI), and with the Bureau of Water, Mines and Energy in Amhara Region, Ethiopia. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher British Geological Survey. Its tags are Ethiopia, Drought, Water security, Rural livelihoods, Socioeconomic. The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
